title: Speed at B
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the speed at point B as approximately 8.9 m/s or 4√5 m/s.

title: Speed at C
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the speed at point C as approximately 16.7 m/s or 2√70 m/s.

title: Energy Conservation Setup
description: Important: Applies conservation of mechanical energy correctly for the A-to-B segment, relating kinetic energy gain to potential energy loss.

title: Energy Conservation Extension
description: Important: Applies conservation of mechanical energy correctly for the B-to-C segment, accounting for the further loss of potential energy.

title: Correct Height Values
description: Important: Uses the correct height differences (h1 from A to B, h2 from B to C) in the energy equations.

title: Algebraic Manipulation
description: Optional: Shows clear algebraic steps to solve for the unknown speeds from the energy equations.

title: Sign Error in Potential Energy
description: Pitfall: Makes a sign error in the potential energy term for the B-to-C segment (e.g., adding mgh2 instead of subtracting).

title: Unit Omission or Mismatch
description: Pitfall: Fails to include correct units (m/s) for final speeds or uses incorrect units.
